Event

NUBIUltimateRunway 2022

Thu, Apr 21, 2022 · 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM · Five Event Cener

When
Thu, Apr 21, 2022 · 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM
Where
Five Event Cener
2917 S Bryant Ave, Minneapolis, Minnesota

The Spring 2022 Nubi show is inspired by the historical fashion of the Nubian/Kush Empire. The fashion on the runway will definitely give you a sense of contemporary and ancient designs.

Not only are we presenting fashion, we also dedicate NUBIUltimateRunway as an event to create a positive culture and represent our diversity in the Twin City.

This event contributes back to supporting those in need in Africa. This year, elders of our community serving at one of the largest refugee camp called Kakuma Camp, have reached out to our brand to support high schooler kids in completing their education towards graduation. These are children who have either lost one or both parents due to the effects of wars. Secondly they are also being impacted by the pandemic/economic crisis.

Due to a large growing population in the camp, the UN has limited their necessities in helping primary schools, while the Secondaries are stranded in their last journey towards graduation. Every child deserves an education and we are proud to take part as a society. This event comes with a cause to change lives and we appreciate all the support we can get.
